title: Register growth in one step
statement: Let $R$ be the number of registers, let $\Lambda$ be a set of labels, and let $P$ assign an instruction to each label. For any input bit string $x$, state $s$, and register $r$, the value of register $r$ after one step of $P$ on $x$ is at most its value in $s$ plus one.
hypotheses_covered: A counter program with $R$ registers and labels in $\Lambda$
replaced:
Let $P$ be a counter program over $R$ registers with labels in $\Lambda$, $x$ an input bit
string, $s$ an abstract state with registers $\rho$, and $r$ a register. If $\rho'$ denotes the
registers of the state reached from $s$ by one step of $P$ on $x$, then
$\rho'(r) \le \rho(r) + 1$.
